name: ZipCheckup U.S. Home Safety and Water Quality Dataset
description: Multi-source Home Safety Score plus accepted EPA SDWIS and ECHO water evidence for U.S. ZIP codes. Water records carry explicit measurement status, accepted quarter and record-year window, four-state violation counts, per-PWSID totals, and typed recent events. EPA transmits no verified copper unit, so copper is reported as an action-level (CU90) exceedance flag, not a concentration.
source: ZipCheckup multi-source civic data; see score model and field provenance

fields.water_data_available: true only when this ZIP has a directly mapped EPA public water system in the exported snapshot; false means all water/system/CCR/enforcement-derived fields are unavailable, not zero. This field does not assert source freshness.
fields.water_violation_measurement_status: measured when the accepted ECHO roster covers every directly mapped PWSID; null when direct water evidence is unavailable
fields.water_violation_source_quarter: Accepted ECHO submission quarter, for example 2026Q2
fields.water_violation_from_year: Inclusive lower record-year bound for accepted violation evidence
fields.water_violation_through_year: Inclusive upper record-year bound for accepted violation evidence
fields.total_violations: All accepted violation records inside the explicit inclusive record-year window
fields.health_violations: Accepted records classified as health-based inside the explicit window
fields.archived_violations: Accepted records with archived status; excluded from current noncompliance
fields.addressed_violations: Accepted records with addressed status; included in current noncompliance under this source contract
fields.unaddressed_violations: Accepted records with unaddressed status; included in current noncompliance
fields.violation_systems: JSON array of measured per-PWSID count partitions that conserve to the ZIP totals
fields.recent_violations: JSON array of recent accepted events with identity, PWSID, year, date, category, exact four-state status and health classification
fields.lead_level_mg_l: 90th percentile lead level (mg/L), null if no data
fields.copper_action_level_exceedance: true = a copper action-level (CU90) exceedance record exists for this ZIP; null = no exceedance record on file / unknown (NOT clean). EPA transmits no verified copper unit, so no concentration is published.
fields.radon_zone: EPA radon zone (1=highest, 3=lowest), null if no data
fields.home_safety_score: Home Safety Score model output from 0 through 100; null when required score coverage is incomplete
fields.home_safety_grade: A/B/C/D/F letter grade; null when the score is unavailable
fields.home_safety_component_scores: Object containing every model component score or null
fields.home_safety_component_status: Object containing observed, missing, or insufficient_coverage status for each component
fields.home_safety_domain_scores: Object containing each equally weighted model-domain score or null
fields.home_safety_coverage: Reconciled score-availability counts and missing component/domain IDs
fields.health_contaminant_names: Semicolon-separated list of health-based contaminant names
fields.ccr_contaminant_count: Number of contaminants reported in Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), null if no CCR data
fields.ccr_violation_count: Evidence-bound CCR violation count. 0 is emitted only for an accepted measured-zero claim; null means unknown/unaccepted.
fields.ccr_violation_status: measured_zero, reported_nonzero, or unknown under the evidence-bound CCR claim contract.
fields.ccr_violation_report_year: Exact report year for an accepted CCR violation claim; null when unknown.
fields.ccr_violation_scope: Named source scope for an accepted CCR violation claim; null when unknown.
fields.ccr_violation_claim: Full evidence-bound CCR violation claim object.
fields.ccr_lsl_claim: Field-level evidence-bound CCR lead-service-line claim object; missing counts remain unknown, never zero.
fields.enforcement_action_count: Total EPA/state enforcement actions against the water system. null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-zero).
fields.enforcement_health_violations: Number of health-based violations from enforcement records. null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-zero).
fields.has_active_issues: Whether the exported source record flags active enforcement or violation issues (true/false). null = enforcement data not available for this ZIP (NOT measured-false).
fields.boil_water_advisories: Reserved. Always null until a source-bound authoritative advisory feed with issue/lift timestamps is admitted.

null_semantics: A null / empty value means the accepted source contract does not cover that ZIP or measure, NOT a measured zero or false. A numeric 0 in the water violation fields is emitted only with water_violation_measurement_status=measured and complete per-PWSID conservation. Do not impute 0/false for absent records.

erratum.issue: Earlier dataset versions emitted enforcement_action_count=0, enforcement_health_violations=0, has_active_issues=false, and boil_water_advisories=0 for ZIP codes that had no enforcement record in the source (23789 ZIPs in this export). This conflated "data not available" with "measured zero / no active issues".
erratum.correction: From this version, those four fields are emitted as null (empty in CSV) when the ZIP is absent from the enforcement source. A 0/false now appears only when it is an actual measured value for a ZIP present in the source.
